cues.en: This video is a follow up to the previous video where I'm going to go through two exercises for the greatest common denominator.
cues.zh: 這段延續上一段，講解兩個最大公因數練習。

cues.en: So if you haven't watched the previous video, then you might want to go back and consult that one before going through the exercise in this video.
cues.zh: 如果還沒看上一段，建議先回去看，再做這裡的練習。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So here is your first exercise. What you want to do is use symbolic variables so that means the sympy
cues.zh: 第一題，用符號變數，也就是 SymPy，

cues.en: module, to illustrate this property of the greatest common denominator. So the property is that C
cues.zh: 模組，展示最大公因數的這個性質。性質是 c，

cues.en: times or the greatest common denominator between C times A and C times B is the same thing as c times
cues.zh: 乘，或者說，ca、cb 的最大公因數，等於 c 乘以，

cues.en: the greatest common denominator between A and B. So C A and B are all integers but in this case you want to show illustrate this in the general case.
cues.zh: a、b 的最大公因數。c、a、b 都是整數，但這裡要展示一般情況，

cues.en: That means using symbolic variables and that means that you should use the G C D function not in the math module but in the sympy module.
cues.zh: 也就是用符號變數。所以要用 SymPy 的 gcd，不是 math 的 gcd。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Once you've shown this for these letters, these symbolic variables, then you can go back and pick some
cues.zh: 用這些字母、符號變數展示後，再選幾個，

cues.en: numbers -- three integers -- and show an example with those numbers that you get the same result for this versus this.
cues.zh: 數字，三個整數，用實例證明，這個和這個得到相同結果。

cues.en: So that is exercise 1.
cues.zh: 這是第一題。

cues.en: Exercise 2 is to create a matrix and in particular you want to create a matrix that contains 10 rows and 15 columns.
cues.zh: 第二題，建立矩陣，具體是 10 列、15 欄，

cues.en: And initially you want to set every element in that 10 by 15 matrix to be ninety nine.
cues.zh: 初始化時，把這個 10 乘 15 矩陣的每個元素都設成 99，

cues.en: So every element in the matrix will be ninety nine. And then you want to populate the matrix.
cues.zh: 全部都是 99，再填入矩陣，

cues.en: So you have to do this in a double for loop such that the element in the i-th row and the j-th column
cues.zh: 使用兩層 for，讓第 i 列、第 j 欄，

cues.en: of The Matrix corresponds to the greatest common denominator between i plus 1 and j plus 1.
cues.zh: 對應 i+1、j+1 的最大公因數，

cues.en: So the row index plus 1 and the column index plus 1.
cues.zh: 也就是列索引加 1、欄索引加 1。

cues.en: All right so pause the video.
cues.zh: 請暫停，

cues.en: Have a go at both of these two exercises.
cues.zh: 試試這兩個練習。

cues.en: And when you're ready to watch me solve these exercises, then come back to the video.
cues.zh: 準備好看我的解法，再回來繼續。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So I already mentioned that we are going to need the sympy toolbox. So let's import sympy as sym
cues.zh: 剛說過，需要 SymPy，import sympy as sym，

cues.en: and I run this cell again and then... let's see, I think I'll actually just delete all of this stuff so we can start from a fresh screen like this.
cues.zh: 重新執行。看看，我把這些全部刪掉，從乾淨畫面開始。

cues.en: So I'm going to begin by creating three symbolic variables A B and C so A B and C equals Sim dot symbols
cues.zh: 先建立 a、b、c 三個符號變數，等於 sym.symbols，

cues.en: and then A space B space
cues.zh: 裡面寫 a、空白、b、空白，

cues.en: C. Okay so now we want to say sym dot greatest common denominator of A times C and B times C and let's
cues.zh: c。接著用 sym.gcd，計算 a*c、b*c 的最大公因數，看看，

cues.en: see what that gives us.
cues.zh: 得到什麼。

cues.en: So that gives us c.
cues.zh: 得到 c。

cues.en: So the thing is we don't already know at this point what a b and c are.
cues.zh: 目前還不知道 a、b、c 的值，

cues.en: However sympy is seeing that it is pretty clear that C is multiplying both a and b.
cues.zh: 但 SymPy 看得出，a、b 都乘了 c，

cues.en: So that's the greatest common denominator that we can come up with given that we don't have any particular values for a and b.
cues.zh: 在沒有 a、b 特定數值的情況，這就是能得到的最大公因數。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Now I'm actually going to encase this in a print function. And now what we want to do is write print
cues.zh: 我把它包進 print。接著寫 print，

cues.en: and then sym dot G C D just with A and B.
cues.zh: 放 sym.gcd(a,b)，

cues.en: And now here the answer is 1.
cues.zh: 這次答案是 1。

cues.en: And again that's because we haven't given sympy enough information and so sympy doesn't have any specific values defined for A and B.
cues.zh: 同樣因為資訊不足，SymPy 沒有 a、b 的特定值，

cues.en: So therefore you can already guess that when we multiply this by C the answer is going to be C.
cues.zh: 所以可以猜到，再乘以 c，就得到 c。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So this was for the general case using symbolic variables.
cues.zh: 這是用符號變數的一般情況，

cues.en: And now I want to repeat this with real numbers.
cues.zh: 再用實際數字重複。

cues.en: Let's say A equals, how about 5. And then I'll make B six and C equals seven. I meant to make this six like that.
cues.zh: a 設 5，b 設 6，c 設 7。我本來就要把這裡設成 6，像這樣。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And now this is going to be almost the same thing as what I have here except now because these are real numbers.
cues.zh: 程式幾乎相同，但因為現在是實際數字，

cues.en: These are not symbolic variables. I'm going to use the math module instead of the symbolic module.
cues.zh: 不是符號，所以用 math 模組，不用符號模組。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And here in both cases we get seven.
cues.zh: 兩種方式都得到 7。

cues.en: Now maybe you think that's a little trivial because there actually are no common multiples of five and six other than one.
cues.zh: 也許你覺得太簡單，因為 5、6 除了 1，沒有其他公因數。

cues.en: So let's make this 15 and six that was like one of the examples that I used in the previous video.
cues.zh: 換成 15、6，和上一段其中一個例子一樣，

cues.en: So here we get one.
cues.zh: 這裡得到 1。

cues.en: Maybe we can change this to two.
cues.zh: 也許把這裡改成 2，

cues.en: The answer is six and maybe three.
cues.zh: 答案是 6，再試 3，

cues.en: And here the answer is nine.
cues.zh: 答案是 9，

cues.en: In both cases so whatever I do with these numbers we seem to get the same answer for both of these and
cues.zh: 兩種方式都一樣。所以不管怎麼改數字，似乎都得到相同答案，

cues.en: this confirms the property of the greatest common denominator that I showed in the slides.
cues.zh: 確認了投影片說明的性質。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Very good.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: Now for the second exercise.
cues.zh: 接著第二題，

cues.en: Now here we need to create a matrix.
cues.zh: 需要建立矩陣，

cues.en: And so to do that I'm going to actually use the numpy module.
cues.zh: 使用 NumPy，

cues.en: So let's say import numpyi as np.
cues.zh: import numpy as np，

cues.en: Run this cell again.
cues.zh: 重新執行，

cues.en: And let's see.
cues.zh: 看看。

cues.en: So the first step is to create the matrix.
cues.zh: 第一步建立矩陣，

cues.en: I'm going to specify the sizes: it was 10 rows and 15 columns.
cues.zh: 先指定尺寸，10 列、15 欄。

cues.en: Now we need to create a matrix.
cues.zh: 接著建立矩陣，

cues.en: Let's call this G C D mat for greatest common denominator matrix.
cues.zh: 叫 gcdmat，代表最大公因數矩陣。

cues.en: So I'm going to set this equal to numpy dot zeroes in here.
cues.zh: 設定成 np.zeros，這裡，

cues.en: I want this matrix to be an n by M matrix.
cues.zh: 需要 n 乘 m 矩陣。

cues.en: And so let's see what this thing looks like.
cues.zh: 看看外觀，

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So this is a matrix.
cues.zh: 這是矩陣，

cues.en: It looks plausibly like it's 10 by 15.
cues.zh: 看起來確實像 10 乘 15，

cues.en: However these are all zeros.
cues.zh: 但全是 0。

cues.en: That's no surprise because I used the function zeros, but the instructions pretty clearly said that every element should be equal to ninety nine.
cues.zh: 不意外，因為用了 zeros，但題目清楚說，每個元素應該是 99。

cues.en: Now there is no function numpy dot ninety nine, nor is there a function nine nine like this.
cues.zh: 沒有 np.ninetynine，也沒有這樣的 nine-nine 函數，

cues.en: Nor for that matter is there a German function nein nein ;) Okay.
cues.zh: 更沒有德文的 nein-nein 函數。好，

cues.en: So we have numpy dot zeros.
cues.zh: 所以用 np.zeros，

cues.en: So basically what I'm gonna do is just say plus ninety nine. And now we get a matrix full of ninety nines.
cues.zh: 再加 99，就得到全部都是 99 的矩陣。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So that completes that part.
cues.zh: 這部分完成。

cues.en: And now what we need to do is write a double for loop and populate each element or define each element
cues.zh: 接著寫兩層 for，填入、定義每個，

cues.en: of this matrix to be the greatest common denominator between the row index and the column index.
cues.zh: 元素，作為列索引、欄索引的最大公因數。

cues.en: So let's say for i in range 0 to n and for j in range 0 to M. And actually, I'm going to change this.
cues.zh: for i in range(0,n)，for j in range(0,m)。其實把名稱改掉，

cues.en: This is going to be the row index and this is going to be the column index.
cues.zh: 這個叫列索引，這個叫欄索引。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: These variable names are a little bit better than i and j, Because they tell us about what we are using these variables for.
cues.zh: 比 i、j 更好的名稱，因為告訴我們變數的用途，

cues.en: So they're a little bit more informative.
cues.zh: 資訊更清楚。

cues.en: So G C D mat and then we want the row i and the col i-th column equals math dot greatest common
cues.zh: gcdmat 的第 rowi 列、第 coli 欄，等於 math.gcd，

cues.en: denominator between row i plus one and col i plus 1.
cues.zh: 輸入 rowi+1、coli+1。

cues.en: All right so let's see.
cues.zh: 好，看看。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So I ran this cell and we got no errors but also nothing printed out. It'd be nice to have a look at this.
cues.zh: 執行沒出錯，但什麼都沒印，最好看一下。

cues.en: Now you saw that this didn't really look so good.
cues.zh: 之前看到，直接印不太好看，

cues.en: Actually, now it looks better that we don't have ninety nines in it. But still, I'm going to use the display math functions to make this look a little bit nicer.
cues.zh: 沒有 99 後，其實現在好看些，但還是用 display、Math 改善外觀。

cues.en: So we need to convert this into latex. sym dot latex is expecting a sympy object as an input. So therefore
cues.zh: 要轉成 LaTeX，而 sym.latex 預期輸入是 SymPy 物件，因此，

cues.en: we need to use sympify to convert this matrix from a numpy array into a sympy object.
cues.zh: 先用 sympify，把 NumPy 陣列轉成 SymPy 物件。

cues.en: This is starting to look good.
cues.zh: 開始像樣了。

cues.en: Now all the ninety nines went away of course, but that's no big deal.
cues.zh: 99 當然全部消失，但沒關係，

cues.en: In fact the only reason why I made this part of the assignment is just to illustrate to you how to initialize
cues.zh: 題目要求這部分，只是想示範如何初始化，

cues.en: a matrix that is not only zeros or only ones, because there's a corresponding function called ones.
cues.zh: 不全是 0、也不全是 1 的矩陣，因為對應也有 ones 函數。

cues.en: So it's kind of an interesting function. If you look down this diagonal here you'll see it goes zero and then two three four five six seven eight nine ten.
And then there's a lot of ones around here and there's some other numbers like twos and threes and fours.
cues.zh: 周圍有很多 1，也有其他數字，像 2、3、4。

cues.en: In fact if you make an image of this matrix then it has a pretty interesting visual appearance.
cues.zh: 如果把矩陣畫成圖片，視覺上很有趣。

cues.en: Now I haven't yet told you how to make images out of matrices but don't worry that's coming up in the
cues.zh: 目前還沒介紹怎麼把矩陣變圖片，別擔心，後面，

cues.en: later part of the course; you will be able to convert a matrix like this into a picture.
cues.zh: 會教，到時就能把這種矩陣轉成圖。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So in this and the previous videos you gained some more experience with the greatest common denominator
cues.zh: 這段和上一段，多練習了最大公因數，

cues.en: as well as working with matrices and populating matrices with the results of mathematical formulas.
cues.zh: 也練習操作矩陣，把數學公式結果填進矩陣。
